title: ⚡️ Congratulating the Iraqi people on the withdrawal of US troops from their country, Major General Mohsen Rezaei said that if the US had succeeded in Iran, it would have sent even more troops to Iraq instead of withdrawing them.
text: ⚡️ Congratulating the Iraqi people on the withdrawal of US troops from their country, Major General Mohsen Rezaei said that if the US had succeeded in Iran, it would have sent even more troops to Iraq instead of withdrawing them.
